derivations: Ideal comparator input draws zero current: (VA-x)/R1+(VB-x)/R2=0, giving x=(R2*VA+R1*VB)/(R1+R2).
For VB=-VL, x=0 gives upper threshold (R1/R2)*VL; for VB=VH, lower threshold is -(R1/R2)*VH.
Threshold span is (R1/R2)*(VH+VL). Dividing by the stated integrator slope VL/(C*R3) gives tL=C*R1*R3*(VH+VL)/(R2*VL).
Return time uses VH, so total T=C*R1*R3*(VH+VL)^2/(R2*VH*VL); unequal saturation magnitudes remain supported.
